# truenas_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a ZFS snapshot on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_dataset" "mydata" {
  name = "tank/mydata"
}

resource "truenas_snapshot" "backup" {
  # Reference the dataset by name rather than hardcoding "tank/mydata", so
  # Terraform creates the dataset before snapshotting it (a hardcoded name
  # gives no dependency edge and can fail on the first apply).
  dataset   = truenas_dataset.mydata.name
  name      = "backup-2026-07-01"
  recursive = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Dataset or zvol to snapshot (e.g. tank/mydata).
- `name` (String) Snapshot name (without @), e.g. snap1.

### Optional

- `recursive` (Boolean) Take recursive snapshot of child datasets (write-only; not stored in state).

### Read-Only

- `createtxg` (String) ZFS transaction group at which the snapshot was created.
- `id` (String) Snapshot identifier in the form "dataset@name".
- `pool` (String) Name of the pool that contains the snapshot.
